note: The vocabulary payloads verbatim — values, not shapes. This is the stated carve-out from the shape-only rule: the vocabulary is platform-owned and account-independent, so nothing in it is anyone's private data. `categories_declared` is the schema's own enum for the `category` argument at probe time; `vocabulary` is keyed by what `list_strategy_categories` actually answered, so a divergence between the two is visible here rather than hidden. Compared against the live platform by tests/live/surface-freshness.test.ts; regenerate with BATTLEGRID_API_KEY=… python3 tools/probe_vocabulary.py
